title: Normal completion and completed regular birational model
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian normal local domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], and put $C=\widehat A=\varprojlim_{r\geq1}A/\mathfrak m^r$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Suppose $f:T\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is proper, $T$ is integral and regular, and $f$ induces an isomorphism of function fields [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-weil-affine-spectrum] [def-pc-integral-scheme] [def-weil-regular-scheme] [def-sc-function-field]. Then $C$ is a complete Noetherian normal local domain, and $T_C=T\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}C$ is integral and regular [def-pc-fibre-product]. The base-changed morphism $f_C:T_C\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ is proper and induces an isomorphism of function fields.
